Protesters Continue Sit-in at Jantar Mantar Over NEET-UG Paper Leak

Activists and members of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) are continuing their sit-in protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi for the third and fourth consecutive days. Led by founder Abhijeet Dipke, the protesters are demanding action regarding the NEET-UG paper leak and have called for an indefinite protest. Activist Sonam Wangchuk has joined the demonstration by beginning a hunger strike, and farmer unions have expressed support.
